actions.name: Hooves
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the skeleton moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition. Minotaur Skeleton

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.text: The solar knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Exalted Restoration
traits.text: If the solar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia. Legendary Resistance (4/Day). If the solar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The solar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
